// Diagnostic observation only; the manifest and its caps have already completed.
const requestedNames = JSON.parse(process.env.PLAN_REQUESTED_NAMES);
const requested = requestedNames.map((name) => {
  const matches = nodeTestNonDistShards.filter((row) => row.check_name === name);
  return { name, matchCount: matches.length, matches };
});
const unmatched = requested.filter((row) => row.matchCount !== 1);
appendFileSync(process.env.PLAN_FINAL_REPORT, JSON.stringify({
  schema: "openclaw-current-merge-node-plan-v1",
  originalFailedCiCheckoutProven: false,
  testsExecuted: false,
  manifest,
  nodeTestDistShards,
  requested,
  unmatched,
  passed: unmatched.length === 0,
}, null, 2) + "\n", "utf8");
if (unmatched.length > 0) {
  throw new Error("Requested current-merge Node names did not each match exactly one admitted row: " +
    unmatched.map(({ name, matchCount }) => `${name} (${matchCount})`).join(", "));
}
